name: indeed_auto_apply
prompt:
The script output above is the JSON summary from the Indeed auto-apply run (indeed_auto_apply.py). Do not run anything yourself; only format that output for WhatsApp.

The same job often appears several times because several search queries find it. List each distinct job (same title and company) exactly once, keeping its first URL.

If "applied" has entries:
✅ Applied: <title> @ <company> (<location>)
<job_url>

If "needs_review" has entries:
✋ Screening: <title> @ <company>
<job_url>

If "external" has entries:
🔗 Company site: <title> @ <company>

If "failed" has entries:
❌ Failed: <title> @ <company> — <reason>

End with one line: "Indeed today: <count> applied"
If the output contains "INDEED_NOT_LOGGED_IN": say exactly "Indeed: session expired, needs a manual Google login from a desktop session" and nothing else.
If applied, needs_review, external and failed are all empty and there is no error: respond with exactly [SILENT].
